transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Well, I came in because for the past few weeks, I've just felt this... this heavy, sad pressure sitting on me almost all day. Even when I'm at work, you know, smiling at my patients, inside I just feel like I'm barely holding myself together.
Have you noticed yourself losing interest in things you used to enjoy, like hobbies, work, or spending time with friends or family?

Yeah, I have. Usually, after my shifts, I would do things to decompress—like I used to paint, or go to yoga, or even salsa dancing. But lately... I just go straight home. I end up just sitting on the couch and ignoring my texts. It just feels like none of it is really worth the effort right now.
Have you been feeling like you’re not good enough, or have you been blaming yourself for things more than usual lately?

No, I haven't really noticed that. Um, I don't feel like I'm doing a bad job or anything. Like, I know I'm a good nurse, and I don't really blame myself for feeling this way. It's... I just feel really drained and flat. So no, I wouldn't say I've been feeling guilty or like I'm not good enough.
Have you noticed a big drop in your energy lately, or been feeling unusually tired even when you haven't done much?

No, I wouldn't say so. I mean, being on my feet all day at the clinic is always tiring, so I'm usually pretty beat after a shift. But I haven't noticed any unusual drop in my energy, or feeling tired when I haven't done anything. Physically, my energy levels feel pretty normal, it's just the interest in doing things that's gone.
Has your mood been consistently low or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, rather than just feeling sad or down at certain times?

Yeah, it has. That's actually why I came in. For the past few weeks, I've just felt this... this heavy, sad pressure sitting on me pretty much all day long. It's not just a passing thing. Even when I'm at work, you know, smiling at my patients and doing my job, inside I feel like I'm barely holding myself together. So yeah, it's pretty constant.
Has this feeling of sadness or low mood been present most of the day, nearly every day, for more than two months now?
No, it hasn't been that long. It's only been about three weeks. Um, it started pretty shortly after I found out I was pregnant.
Have you completely stopped enjoying things that used to make you happy, or is there still some enjoyment, even if you're not motivated to do them?

I think I've pretty much stopped enjoying them altogether. Um, usually after my shifts, I used to paint, or go to yoga, or even do salsa dancing just to decompress. But lately... I just go straight home and sit on the couch. I've been ignoring texts from friends, too, because... well, none of it really feels worth the effort anymore. Even if I did try to do those things, I just don't feel like I'd get any happiness out of them right now.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently, like eating a lot less or more than usual, or losing or gaining weight without trying?

Yeah, my appetite has definitely changed. I know I should be eating regularly, especially now that I'm pregnant, but... most days food just sounds completely unappealing. Like, I'll be halfway through a shift at the clinic and suddenly realize all I've had all day is just some crackers or a cup of coffee. I just don't have the desire to eat much at all.
